messageCenterItems.title: Outlook: Insert Symbols
messageCenterItems.summary: Starting mid-October 2026, Outlook will roll out the ability to insert symbols into emails via the Insert tab, completing by late January 2027. This feature affects users on new Outlook for Windows and web, requires no admin action, and enhances message composition with special characters.
messageCenterItems.body:
Updated November 16, 2026: We have updated the timeline. Thank you for your patience. 

What and Why:

A variety of symbols can be added to an email message that you are composing. On the Insert tab, select Symbols.

Rollout Schedule:

General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out early January 2027 (previously late November 2026) and expect to complete by late January 2027 (previously late December 2026).

Targeted Release (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out on mid-October 2026 and expect to complete by mid-November 2026 (previously early November).

General Availability (GCC): We will begin rolling out on early January 2027 (previously late November 2026) and expect to complete by late January 2027 (previously late December 2026).

General Availability (GCC High): We will begin rolling out on early January 2027 (previously late November 2026) and expect to complete by late January 2027 (previously late December 2026).

General Availability (DoD): We will begin rolling out on early January 2027 (previously late November 2026) and expect to complete by late January 2027 (previously late December 2026).

Impact on Your Organization:

Who is affected:

  • Users composing emails in new Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web.
  • Help desk and training teams that support Outlook message composition experiences.

Platforms/Services:

  • Exchange Online.
  • New Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web.

What will happen:

  • Users will be able to insert symbols into email messages from the Insert tab.
  • This adds a built-in way to include special characters and symbols while composing messages.
  • The capability will roll out automatically during the scheduled rollout window.

Action Required/Recommendations:

  • No admin action is required.
  • Inform users that symbols can be inserted from the Insert tab when composing email.
  • Update internal Outlook training or help desk guidance if it references how users add special characters to messages.

Compliance considerations:

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.

----------------------------For Processing Do Not Delete------------------------------

Do you need to update your Service description: No
